description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for compatibility endpoints related to submissions, including creating, running quality gates, approving, and publishing submissions. It uses models, external services, and database interactions to support test payloads and ensure minimal submission states for testing.

classes.name: SimplifiedSubmissionPayload
classes.description: Pydantic model for simplified submission payload used for test compatibility, with validation logic.

methods.name: _validate_payload
methods.description: Validates the payload to ensure it includes either (name+version) or draft_id or package, and artifacts are non-empty if simplified.

methods.name: get_or_create_test_user
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a test user in the database for anonymous requests.

methods.name: ensure_submission_exists_for_tests
methods.description: Ensures a minimal draft and submission exist for a given submission ID, creating them if necessary for testing.

methods.name: create_submission_compat
methods.description: Handles creation of submissions via simplified payloads, supporting different input paths and duplicate checks.

methods.name: run_quality_gates_compat
methods.description: Triggers validation on a submission, ensuring it exists for tests, and returns validation results.

methods.name: approve_submission_compat
methods.description: Approves a submission if authorized, enforcing segregation of duties.

methods.name: publish_submission_compat
methods.description: Publishes a submission, auto-provisioning if missing, and returns the publish status.
